title: NFL Draft 2026: Running back position may be devalued, but the safest pick is probably Jeremiyah Love

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Draft 2026: Running back position may be devalued, but the safest pick is probably Jeremiyah Love
sources.description: The recent hit rate on first-round running backs is actually pretty high, and Jeremiyah Love looks like he's next in line. But there's a key question any team interested in drafting him early must ask itself.
